newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Fresh Indonesian campaign violence flares.
newsitem.headline: Fresh Indonesian campaign violence flares.

text.p: Supporters of Indonesia's ruling Golkar fought with backers of a rival Moslem-oriented minority party during a Golkar campaign election rally in south Jakarta on Sunday, witnesses said.
The witnesses said riot police were called up to control the situation as sporadic clashes continued.
The fighting started when a convoy of vehicles carrying Golkar supporters from a rally drove through an area heavily populated by backers of the minority United Development Party (PPP).
Witnesses said about 1,000 people were involved in the Sunday fighting. Police blocked off surrounding streets and shops closed their doors.
There were no immediate reports of casualties or arrests.

On Saturday, police had used tear gas, rubber bullets and shots in the air to disperse thousands of PPP supporters in another Jakarta area protesting over being barred from a street previously open to Golkar.
